headline: Wardens Retake Moltworth as Colonials Breach Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Since the midday dispatch, Wardens have struck back in Viper Pit to recapture Moltworth, restoring total faction control over the territory behind three sharp base actions. In Callahan’s Passage, the front has ruptured under heavy assault; Colonials seized two strategic redoubts amid five rapid shifts and over twenty-three hundred casualties across two hours, centered on The Latch and the Crumbling works. Along the Nevish Line, base exchanges ground to a halt, leaving Colonials clinging to two positions under sustained attrition. Fresh volatility stirred Stlican Shelf, where two transfers pushed casualty rates upward and reduced one base to no-man’s-land, leaving the hex partitioned between six Colonial and two Warden strongholds. Meanwhile, Weathered Expanse witnessed an astonishing crescendo of carnage, devouring more than thirty-two hundred men in two hours as casualty rates accelerated sharply without shifting the map. In Mooring County, rising bloodshed marked ongoing fighting around the lone Colonial wedge, whereas Fisherman's Row cooled markedly to a solitary transfer.
